title: 6-digit pairing code creates a Bridge device
when: Admin: Settings → Printers → Set up printer helper; POST /api/bridge/pair with the code; reuse the code; wrong code 11 times
then: Code shown in UI (6 digits, expiry text); pair returns device_key for that restaurant; reuse → 400; 11th wrong try → 429; key works for /api/bridge/jobs

title: createBridge module used by CLI and app
when: Run bridge CLI against fake printers (B-02 path)
then: Still prints kitchen ticket and receipt; bridge/index.js is a thin CLI over the module

title: Printer app first run (dev mode on Linux)
when: npm --prefix desktop start with a scratch app-data dir (xvfb if needed); enter a pairing code; Find printers with a fake TCP 9100 listener on a local address; Print test page
then: Window shows the 3 steps; pairing succeeds; the fake printer on 9100 is listed; test page bytes arrive; app does NOT start a POS server (no listener on 4000)

title: Packaging config is printer-only
when: Inspect desktop/package.json build config and the workflow
then: productName 'HazelPOS Printer'; no server/client/rag extraResources; workflow updated

title: Docker image builds and runs
when: docker build (or podman if docker is absent; if neither exists, mark SKIPPED with reason) and run with a volume and production env
then: Container healthy; /api/health 200; data survives container restart with the same volume

title: Production refuses unsafe config
when: NODE_ENV=production with: no VENDOR_API_KEY; BASE_URL http://; OTP_OFF=1; RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT=x with DATA_DIR outside RAILWAY_VOLUME_MOUNT_PATH
then: Each refuses to start with a clear message; with all correct it starts

title: Hourly backups rotate and restore works
when: Trigger backup run several times with faked clock; restore one restaurant from a backup after changing its data
then: Folders rotate per policy; restore brings back the old data for that restaurant only; the other restaurant unchanged

title: DEPLOY.md is complete and accurate
when: Read docs/online/DEPLOY.md against the code (env var names, commands, ports)
then: Every env var the server/admin reads in production is listed and correct; steps are in order; nothing references the old installer/activation flow

title: Slices A–D still pass
when: Re-run the A api suite, B-02/B-04, C-05/C-09, D-01/D-05
